pay.title: Pay
pay.nativeMissing: Payments need the latest app build. Reinstall the dev client to pay in-app.
pay.finalizingBody: Your card was charged. This can take a moment to confirm — check My bookings shortly.

pay.finalAmountNote: The shop sets the final amount; your card is charged the total shown at checkout.

deposit.finalizingBody: Your card was charged. It can take a moment to confirm — check My bookings shortly.
deposit.headingRequired: A deposit is required to book

deposit.appliedNote: The deposit is applied to your balance — you only pay the rest at checkout.
deposit.forfeitBoth: If you cancel or miss the appointment, the deposit is not refunded.
deposit.forfeitCancel: If you cancel, the deposit is not refunded.
deposit.forfeitNoShow: If you miss the appointment, the deposit is not refunded.
deposit.refundedOnCancel: If you cancel, the deposit is refunded.
